Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase. The player are out in the middle. Takudzwanashe Kaitano and Innocent Kaia are the openers for Zimbabwe. Deepak Chahar to start proceedings with the ball. Let's play...  Oh!..What happened there. Deepak Chahar starts his run-up to bowl the first ball but he stops and dislodges the bails at the non-striker's end and gives a smile to Innocent Kaia there. The replay shows that Kaia was out of his crease and he would have been out but India did not appeal for that.
... THE RUN CHASE ...

Now this is going to be a stiff chase for a side which is yet to cross the 200-run mark this series. They though have done well chasing in the past. Can they gun this down? India on the other hand will back their bowlers to defend it. Stay tuned for the chase in a bit.

Zimbabwe began well with the ball but failed to control things in the middle overs, especially when Gill and Kishan were batting. However, they will be pleased to keep India under the 300-run mark in the end. A lot of the credit has to go to Evans who was brilliant with a fifer. Just the two others took wickets, the rest went wicket-less. However, Raza and Victor Nyauchi bowled with good economy rates.

After electing to bat, the openers began slowly. Both Rahul and Dhawan took their time but both fell after getting off to starts. India were in a spot of bother then but Kishan and Gill played brilliantly. The two added over 100 with both getting to their half tons. Kishan was run out but Gill continued. He kept losing partners at the other end but he continued scoring freely. Shubman Gill got up a well-deserved ton, his first in ODIs and has taken India into a strong position. Had it not been for him, India maye have ended with something below 250.

That innings from Gill could well be the difference between the two sides! His ton has taken India to what we feel is a total which is above par. Gill just seemed like he is batting on a different wicket and he is the reason for India being on top.
A couple of runs to end the innings! This is overpitched and on middle, Kuldeep Yadav whips it towards deep mid-wicket for a brace. India finishes on 289 for 8.
Another good slower ball, on a length and outside off, Kuldeep Yadav throws his bat at it but cannot connect.
A yorker, on off, Deepak Chahar digs it to point for one.

OUT! TAKEN! Brad Evans gets his fifth wicket and he is delighted. A slower ball this time, on middle, Shardul Thakur gets deceived by it and is into his heave early. It goes of the top edge and high in the air, Victor Nyauchi at cover runs towards it and takes an easy catch. We saw a maiden ODI hundred from Gill and now Brad Evans gets his maiden five-wicket haul. Kuldeep Yadav is the next batter in for India.
Commentary.Howout: c Victor Nyauchi b Brad Evans

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! This is full and on off, Shardul Thakur smashes it wide of the long off fielder for a boundary.

OUT! TAKEN! Shubman Gill walks back after an incredible innings here. This is on a good length and outside off, Shubman Gill moves across to smoke it over long off but his bat rolls in his hand as he connects with the ball. As a result, it goes high in the air and does not get the elevation. Innocent Kaia there takes nice catch. The crowd shows its appreciation while Gill walks back and he acknowledges it. Deepak Chahar comes out to bat now.
Commentary.Howout: c Innocent Kaia b Brad Evans

Commentary.Commentary: Brad Evans is ready to bowl the last over.
Nails the yorker this time, outside off, Shubman Gill manages to squeeze it past point for a single. Gill will be on strike for the last over.
Overpitched and outside off, Shardul Thakur drills it towards long off for just one.
FOUR! Thakur puts this one away nicely! This is full and around off, Shardul Thakur stays there and carasses it past the diving cover fielder for a boundary.
Length delivery this time, on off, Shardul Thakur uses his feet to play a lofted cover drive but gets beaten again.
Swing and a miss! This is full and outside off, angling away, Shardul Thakur slashes at it but connects with thin air.
This is overpitched, outside off, Shubman Gill drills it towards long off for one.
Full and around middle, Shubman Gill drives to long on for a single.
A yorker, on middle, Shubman Gill squeezes it past the bowler and towards long on, he runs the first one hard and calls Thakur for the second as well and completes it easily in the end.

OUT! CAUGHT! Another man bites the dust! Victor Nyauchi bowls this on a good length and around off, Axar Patel goes for the big shot over long off but mistimes it badly in the air, Sikandar Raza there did not have to move an inch as he pouches it safely. India six down now.
Commentary.Howout: c Sikandar Raza b Victor Nyauchi

Commentary.Commentary: Another full delivery, on middle, Shubman Gill uses his feet and eases it towards long on for a single. Raza does well to keep it down to a run but cutting it out quickly.
Good running there! This is on a yorker length, on leg, Shubman Gill squeezes it towards the vacant mid-wicket region for a brace.
FOUR! Stand and deliver! This is overpitched and on off, in the slot as well, Shubman Gill stays there and heaves it wide of the deep mid-wicket fielder for a boundary.
WIDE! Full but way down the leg side, Gill misses his flick. Wided.
Well bowled! This is on a yorker length, on middle, Axar Patel digs it out towards mid off.
WIDE! Bangs a bouncer but down the leg. Wided.
Back of a length, on middle, Axar Patel tucks it towards mid-wicket.
Full again and around off, Shubman Gill drills it towards deep point for one.
MISFIELD AND FOUR! This is full and on middle, Shubman Gill lofts it towards the long on fence, the fielder there misjudges the bounce and lets it go through his hands and towards the fence.
On a length and on middle, Axar Patel works it towards short mid-wicket for a quick single.
Full and outside off, Shubman Gill drives it towards long off for a single.

OUT! TAKEN! Sanju Samson goes for the big shot again but holes out this time. Luke Jongwe bowls this fuller and on middle and leg, Sanju Samson whips it away to the leg side but does not get the connection right as it goes of the toe end and high up in the air towards deep square leg. Takudzwanashe Kaitano there settles under it and competes a nice catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Takudzwanashe Kaitano b Luke Jongwe

Commentary.Commentary: SIX! Another one for Samson! This is on a good length and on off, Sanju Samson picks up the length early and lofts it over the long off fence for another maximum.
SIX! HUGE! Luke Jongwe bowls this full and on middle, Sanju Samson stays there and smokes it over the bowler's head for a biggie.
Bangs in a bouncer and on middle, Sanju Samson ducks under it.

DROPPED! This is short and on middle and leg, Shubman Gill pulls it straight towards short fine leg, Victor Nyauchi moves to his right but cannot grab it. Another oppurtunity lost. A single in the end.
Luke Jongwe comes back into the attack and starts with a short delivery, on off, Sanju Samson upper cuts it towards third man for a single.
SIX! Over the fence! This is short and on the body, it is pulled over the fine leg fence for a biggie.
Angled into the pads, Samson looks to flick but misses. It htis the pad and rolls on the leg side. A leg bye taken.
That does not bounce! Shorter and on middle, Samson looks to pull, this one stays low and goes just over the middle pole.
Outside off, Samson leaves it alone.
Short and on middle, Gill looks to flat bat it but it goes off the splice towards mid off for one.
On middle, this is guided down to third man for one.
FOUR! Slapped over! Short and outside off, Gill steps out and slaps it over cover for a boundary.
On middle, Samson pushes it down to long on and takes one.
Three dots in a row as this is blocked.
On middle, this is pushed to cover.
Fuller and on middle, this is played back to the bowler.

100 for Gill! His first and one he will remember. Superb, superb knock, Most of the batters have struggled on this wicket but he has made it look so easy. He missed out on one in West Indies but has not had to wait long for his first in ODIs. He gets there by pushing this towards cover for one. Can he take India to above 300?
Sanju Samson comes out to the middle now.

OUT! TIMBER! That is an absolute jaffa of a delivery! Wow! Just how do you play those! Length and on off, this lands and comes back in. Hooda looks to push at it but this sneaks between bat and pad and hits the top of off. These are important wickets. It could stop India from crossing the 300-run mark.
On off, this is pushed through covers for one more.
Angled into the pads, Hooda works it through mid-wicket for one.
On off, this is pushed to covers.
A single as this is worked down to fine leg.

OUT! It is Kishan who has to take the long walk back as the review taken by Zimbabwe was not a successful one. GILL HAD AN INSIDE EDGE AND HE CONTINUES! However, Zimbabwe get the wicket they so desperately wanted. A new batter heading into the last phase of the game is what they would have hoped for! This is on middle, Gill looks to flick but misses. He gets hit on the pads.An appeal but turned down. Kishan is off for a run but is sent back from halfway down. The fielder at point, picks the ball up and hits the stumps at the bowler's end. Kishan starts walking back but Zimbabwe have reviewed for an LBW. Replays show there is an inside edge.
Zimbabwe have taken a review for the LBW for Shubman Gill. The UltraEdge shows that there is some bat involved and the on field decision of Not out remains.
On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Two! He moves onto 96! On the pads, this is worked past short fine leg. The deep square leg fielder runs to his right, slides and keeps it down to two.
On off, Kishan pushes it through covers for one. Fifty for him. Solid knock. Took his time at the start but now has hit top gear.
Slower one and on off, this is pushed to cover.
Another single as Gill plays this through covers.
On off, this is pushed through covers for one.
On middle, this is played through mid-wicket for one more.
Shorter and on middle, this is pulled through square leg for one.
On off, this is pushed through covers for one.
Shorter and outside off, this is guided through point for one.
FOUR! On the pads, this is worked fine on the leg side and it races away to the fence. Gill into the 90s.
Fuller and on off, this is pushed to mid off.
This on a good length, on middle, slower too, Shubman Gill pushes it with soft hands towards mid off for a quick single.
Shorish again, on middle, Shubman Gill pulls it wide of the deep mid-wicket fielder for a brace.
Short and on middle, Ishan Kishan pulls it towards deep square leg for a run.

MISFIELD AND FOUR! This is full and on off, Ishan Kishan leans on and just pushes it towards mid off and sets off for a run, the fielder there tries to charge towards the ball but lets it go through his leg and the ball races away to the long on fence. Poor from Zimbabwe in the field yet again.
On a length and on middle, Shubman Gill tucks it away through square leg for a single.
Starts with a short delivery and outside off, Shubman Gill slaps it past the covers fielder for a comfortable brace.
Short and on middle, Shubman Gill pulls it through square leg for one.

FOUR! Nice placement! This is short again and with width on offer, Shubman Gill stays there and cuts it past the point fielder for a boundary. That was not from the middle of the bat but he finds the gap with ease.
Richard Ngarava continues bowling short here, on midle, Ishan Kishan works it of his back foot through sqaure leg for a single.
Another short ball, on middle, Shubman Gill again pulls it well but this time straight towards the deep square leg fielder. A single taken.
Short again and on middle, Shubman Gill goes back in his crease and pulls it hard wide of the deep square leg fielder for a brace.
WIDE! Bangs in bouncer but down the leg, Shubman Gill ducks under it. Wided.
Richard Ngarava comes 'round the wicket and serves a length ball, on off, angling away, Shubman Gill cuts it of the toe end towards point.
Slower one, short and outside off, Shubman Gill cuts it to deep point for a single.

This is short of a length, on middle, Ishan Kishan stays there and flicks it towards the vacant fine leg region, the fielder from short fine leg gives a chase and dives to keep the ball in. The batters run three.
On a length and on the fifth stump line, Ishan Kishan looks to push it to the off side but gets an bottom edge onto the ground and towards the keeper.

Short and outside off, Ishan Kishan cuts it of his back foot towards sweeper cover where a fumble allows the batters to come back for the second. WIth that, the 100 partnership comes up between these two.
A slower length ball, on middle, angling in, Ishan Kishan is early into his pull shot and misses to get hit on his body.
Back of a length and around off, Shubman Gill hops up and punches it through covers for a single.

Drinks! This partnership has turned the tide of the game towards the Indians and they are well on path to get to over 275 now. Both are set and now have also stepped on the gas. Zimbabwe need wickets or they'll be chasing what we feel will be an above par total on this wicket. An interesting passage follows.

FOUR! Lucky boundary but they all count! This is again on a hard length and outside off, Ishan Kishan slashes hard at it but gets an outside edge and it has enough legs to beat the third man fielder to go into the fence.
Short of a length, on off, angling in, Ishan Kishan gets hurried and gets hit high on his body while trying to block it.
This is on a good length, on middle, Shubman Gill stays there and knocks it towards mid on for a quick single.
FOUR! Fabulous shot! This is just short of a length and outside off, Shubman Gill stays in his crease and smashes it through covers for a boundary. Not a bad delivery but Gill shows his class.
On a hard length, on middle, Ishan Kishan tucks it away through square leg for one.
This is on a good length and outside off, Shubman Gill tries to cut it but gets a thick outside edge towards third man for a single.
A single now as this is pushed down to long on.
FOUR! Lovely shot again. India upping the ante now! The slog sweep comes out, it is hit over mid-wicket for another boundary.
A single as this is pushed down to long off.
On middle, kept out.
FOUR! Out comes the slog sweep and it is nailed, over the mid-wicket fielder and into the fence.
On off, this is pushed to cover.
Flighted delivery, on off, Ishan Kishan forces it towards long off using his feet for a run.
Full and on off, Shubman Gill pushes it wide of covers for one.
FOUR! Another fine shot from Gill! This is short again, on off, Shubman Gill leans on but then goes back in his crease to punch this through covers for a boundary.
Again shorter in length, on middle, Ishan Kishan stays back and nudges it through square leg for one.
Shorish in length, on middle, skids through, Shubman Gill dabs it towards long off for a run.
FOUR! Nice shot! This is tossed up, full and on leg, Shubman Gill goes down and sweeps it fine towards the deep backward sqaure leg fence for a boundary. He is looking in fine touch here.
FIFTY up for Shubman Gill! This is short and on middle, Shubman Gill pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a single. This has been an excellent knock by him. Can he get to the century now?
On off kept out.
Short and outside off, Shubman Gill goes on his back foot and punches it towards sweeper cover for a brace.
Full and on middle, Shubman Gill works it towards short mid-wicket.
Goes short and around off, Ishan Kishan cuts it towards sweeper cover for one.
Raza bowls this short, on middle, Shubman Gill eases it towards long on for an easy single.
A bit short and outside off, Ishan Kishan cuts it but straight to point.
Floats this one up, full and on middle, Shubman Gill drives it towards long on for one more.
Short again, on middle, Shubman Gill blocks it out.
Goes short and on middle, Ishan Kishan tucks it away through sqaure leg for one.
Tossed up, full and on off, Ishan Kishan uses his feet and knocks it towards covers.
Short and on off, Shubman Gill slaps it towards long off for one.
FOUR! Kishan has decided to take Raza on here. This is flighted, full and on middle, Ishan Kishan slams it wide of the long on fielder for another boundary.
On middle, blocked out.
Full and on on, Ishan Kishan knocks it towards mid off.
Short and on off, quciker too, Ishan Kishan gets cramped and cuts it towards point.

FOUR! Fine shot! This is again tossed up, full and on middle, Ishan Kishan goes down and slog-sweeps it towards the deep mid-wicket fence for a boundary. The 50 runs partnership between these two comes up with that.
Tossed up, full and on off, Shubman Gill pushes it towards long off for a single. Raza is not happy with himself as he could not cut it out.
Fuller one, on middle, Shubman Gill works it towards long on for a single. Only 2 runs from the over.
Goes short and on middle, Ishan Kishan goes back and pulls it towards deep square leg for a single.
Flatter and full, on middle, Ishan Kishan hits it back to the bowler.
Another dot! This is tossed up, full and on off, Ishan Kishan pushes it towards covers.
On middle again, blocked out.
Floated and around middle, Ishan Kishan uses his feet and blocks it out.
Tossed up around middle, Shubman Gill knocks it back to the bowler.
Flights this one up, lands short and on middle, turning in, Ishan Kishan makes room and tucks it through mid-wicket for just one.
Floated, full and on leg, Shubman Gill drives it towards long on for another single.
A bit short and on middle, Ishan Kishan stays back and forces it towards long on for one more.
Full agian but this time on middle, Shubman Gill eases it towards long on for one.
Tossed up, full and on off, Shubman Gill knocks it towards covers.
Short and outside off, Shubman Gill cuts it to deep point for one.
On middle, blocked out.
FOUR! Beautiful shot! This is tossed up and around middle, Shubman Gill moves across and scoops it fine towards the vacant fine leg fence for a boundary.
Looped up, lands full and on off, Ishan Kishan drives it firmly through covers for a single.
Floated, full and on leg, Ishan Kishan pushes it to the left of the bowler.
Tossed up, full and on middle, Ishan Kishan blocks it out.
A single to end as this is pushed down to long on.
On off, this is guided to point.
Fuller and on middle, it is clipped through mid-wicket for one.
On off, this is pushed to cover.
On middle, Kishan plays it to mid-wicket.
Shorter and on middle, this is pushed down to long on for one.
A run to end! On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.

DROPPED! That should have been taken! An easy caught and bowled chance! Floats it up, lands it on off, this one holds in the surface. Kishan plays a check-drive, it goes back uppishly towards the bowler who spills it. He should have taken that. A single in the end.
On middle, kept out.
Flatter and on middle, defended.
FOUR! Up and over! Kishan steps out, he gets to the pitch of it and hits it down the ground for a boundary.
On middle, this is pushed down to long on for one.
We will see spin from both ends as Sean Williams has been brought into the attack now.
Flatter and on the stumps, blocked.
On middle, defended.
Another single as it s Gill this time who flicks it on the leg side.
A single now as this is worked through mid-wicket.
Another short one, this is pulled through mid-wicket for one more.
On off, this is pushed to cover.
Shorter and on middle, this is pulled through square leg for one.
On middle, defended.
FOUR! Another wonderful stroke! Fuller and on middle, this is driven wonderfully past the mid on fielder for another boundary.
Outside off, on a length. Left alone.
Angled into middle, Gill works it to mid-wicket.
Another extra! Down the leg side. Wided.

FOUR! That is crisp! Gill has timed that brilliantly! What a shot! Fuller and on off, Gill leans into it and creams it through covers for a boundary. He seems to be batting on a different wicket, he is scoring quite freely.
Flatter and on middle, this one stays low. Kishan manages to get his bat down in time and block it. Maiden from Raza.
Attacks the stumps again, Kishan pushes it to covers.
On middle, blocked.
Shorter and on off, this is pushed to cover.
On the stumps, defended again.
On middle, defended.
Shorter and on off, Kishan slaps it through covers for one.
Another one on the stumps, Kishan is solid in defense.
On off, kept out.
Angled into the pads, this is worked through square leg for one.
WIDE! Down the leg side this time, not played at. Wided.
FOUR! Nice and fine! Poor ball and put away! On the pads, Gill works it fine on the leg side and the ball races away to the fence.
On off, this is pushed to cover.
Luke Jongwe comes into the attack now.
Another one on the stumps, kept out.
On middle, defended.
Shorter and outside off, this is guided past point for one.
On the stumps, defended solidly.
On middle, defended.
FOUR! That is glorious! We saw an on-drive from him earlier on but this is better! Flatter and on off, Gill yet again shows the maker's name and caresses it through covers for a boundary.
Ishan Kishan walks out to bat now.

OUT! TAKEN! That is a team dismissal! Dhawan falls after getting off to a start! He just never looked settle, not sure if that is because of the wicket or what but his run finally runs out! Evans does the job yet again for his side. On middle, Dhawan looks to work it on the leg side but the ball comes slow off the surface. It goes off the leading edge and it is an easy catch to the fielder at covers. Sean Williams makes no mistake. Good from Zimbabwe so far.
Commentary.Howout: c Sean Williams b Brad Evans

Commentary.Commentary: A single to follow the boundary! Shorter and outside off, this is cut hard but towards point. The fielder makes a half stop. A single taken.
FOUR! That is wonderful! Sheer timing! On middle, Gill shows the full face of the bat and creams it past the mid on fielder for a boundary. He just timed it, did not look to hit it hard.
Back of a length and on off, this is pushed to cover.
Shorter and on the body, this is pulled through square leg for one.
On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Flights this one up, short and on middle, turning away, Shikhar Dhawan guides it towards point where the fielder fumbles and the batters calls for the single, but decides against it in the end.
Short and on middle, Shubman Gill works it through square leg for another run.
Full again, on middle, Shikhar Dhawan sweeps it through square leg for one.
FOUR! Dhawan finally finds the fence. This is tossed up, full and on middle, Shikhar Dhawan dances down the track and heaves it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Quicker one, full and on middle, keeps low, Shubman Gill looks to block it but gets it of the bottom edge towards short third man for a run.
Flatter, short and on middle, Shubman Gill pushes it to the right of the bowler where Raza cuts it out.
Short of a length, on middle, angling in, Shikhar Dhawan stays there and blocks it to the off side.
Full again and down the leg, Shubman Gill flicks it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Goes fuller, on middle, Shubman Gill tucks it towards mid-wicket.
Evans bowls this on a good length, on off, nips back in, Shubman Gill watches it all the way through and leaves it. Good cricket all around!
Length agian, on off, Shikhar Dhawan punches of his back foot through covers for one.
This is on hard length and outside off, Shikhar Dhawan stays there and slashes at it but cannot connect.
Tossed up, full and on off, Shikhar Dhawan drives and finds the gap through covers for a single. Another good over from Raza.
Darts this one, on leg, Shikhar Dhawan misses his flick and gets hit on the pads and the ball goes nowhere.
Short and on off, Shikhar Dhawan cuts it but finds the fielder at point. Another dot!
Three dots on the trot! This is full, on middle, Shikhar Dhawan uses his feet and works it straight to short mid-wicket.
A bit short, on middle, Shikhar Dhawan pushes it towards extra covers.
Floated, full and on off, Shikhar Dhawan knocks it back to the bowler.
This is on a good length, on middle, Shubman Gill nudges it towards mid-wicket.
Another full delivery, on the pads, Shikhar Dhawan tucks it away towards deep square leg for one more.
Full again, on off, angling in, Shikhar Dhawan pushes it towards point.
Goes fuller this time, on middle, Shubman Gill moves across and flicks it thorugh sqaure leg for one and gets off the mark.
This is on a hard length and outside off, Shikhar Dhawan guides it past point for a single.
On a good length and on middle, Shikhar Dhawan works it towards mid-wicket and calls for the run but Gill denies and rightly so.
Tossed up, full and on middle, Shubman Gill blocks it towards point.
A bit short, on middle, Shikhar Dhawan goes back and slaps it towards long on for a single.
Floated, full and on middle, Shikhar Dhawan flicks it towards mid-wicket.
Darts this one, on a yorker length, on middle, Shikhar Dhawan digs it out towards the bowler.
Goes a bit fuller, on middle, Shikhar Dhawan pushes it towards short mid-wicket.
Starts with a short delivery, on off, Shikhar Dhawan knocks it towards covers.

DRINKS! Zimbabwe have done well so far! They have kept it nice and tight and now have got the wicket of Rahul. They will hope they can continue the good work from the break. India on the other hand, will now have to re-build again. They would hope these two can lay a platform for a big score.

OUT! CHOPPED ON! Brad Evans provides the breakthrough and Rahul has to go back to the hut. Evans bowls this a bit short and outside off, KL Rahul tries to cut it close from his body but only manages to get an inside edge and the ball crashes into the stumps. KL Rahul did not look comfortable in the middle and his stay has come to an end. Zimbabwe are delighted.
On a length, on middle, KL Rahul looks to push it away but gets an inside edge onto his pads.

SIX! BANG! That is the first maximum of the innings. Brad Evans bangs a short ball, on middle, KL Rahul gets into position quickly and hooks it over the diving deep backward sqaure leg fielder for a biggie.
Back of a length, on off, KL Rahul stands tall and blocks it towards covers.
On a length and around off, Shikhar Dhawan takes a couple step forward and pushes it of the inner half through sqaure leg foe one.
Short and on middle, keeps a bit low, KL Rahul adjusts and pulls it towards deep sqaure leg for a single.
Bangs in a bouncer, on middle, Shikhar Dhawan again skips down the track but ducks under it.
Dhawan comes down the track again, Victor Nyauchi sees this and serves a short of length ball, angling in, Shikhar Dhawan only manages to knock this one to the leg side.
Fuller one, on middle, KL Rahul nudges it towards short mid-wicket for a quick single.
This is on a good length, on off, KL Rahul stays there and guides it towards short third man.
Full again but this time on the pads, KL Rahul flicks it through square leg for a couple of runs.
Full and on middle, KL Rahul works it towards mid-wicket.
Pulls his length back, on middle, Shikhar Dhawan bunts it onto the ground to the leg side and sets off for the run but Rahul gives a loud shout of 'No run'.
Goes a bit fuller, on middle and leg, Shikhar Dhawan tucks it towards square leg.

This is on a good length and outside off, Shikhar Dhawan cuts it wide of the third man fielder for a brace. The fielder there does well to make the ground and dives to his left to cut it out with his shoulder as his knee got stuck in the ground.
Evans goes over the wicket and serves a full delivery, on middle, angling in, Shikhar Dhawan blocks it back to the bowler.
On a length and around off, KL Rahul stays back and knocks it towards cover-point for a single.
Full delivery and on middle, hint of swing, KL Rahul pushes it towards mid off.
A single to end the over as this is pushed through covers.
Half an appeal! This is on a length and outside off, it jags back in. Rahul looks to defend but planting his front foot outside the line of off. It hits the front pad. An appeal but turned down.
Dhawan now waits and then plays it down to third man for one.
Around off, this is guided down to third man for one.
On off, this is pushed to cover.
Another delivery outside off, easy leave.Rahul continues to be watchful.
Back of a length and on off, defended.
On off, Rahul guides it down to third man for one.
On the stumps, kept out.
Around off, Rahul looks to play at it but then pulls his bat back.
FOUR! Nicely timed! Shorter and on off, Rahul waits and then pushes it through covers for a boundary.
On the off pole, kept out.
Powerplay 2! The fielding side can now have up to 4 players outside the 30-yard circle till the 40th over. Also, Brad Evans is into the attack for Zimbabwe.
On off, Dhawan steps out and defends. End of Powerplay 1 and it has been a sedate start from India.
Good length and on off, defended.
Another mere push! Fuller and on off, Rahul leans into the stroke and pushes it through covers. Three taken.
Slips this one down the leg side, wided.
Outside off yet again, left alone.
Pokes at one which is just outside off, he gets beaten as the ball lands and moves away.
Outside off, left alone.
A dot to end! A little too full, Dhawan looks to drive but it goes off the inner half to mid on.

FOUR! That is a lovely shot from Dhawan! He did not look to hit it hard, just used the pace! Shorter and on middle, Dhawan plays the upper cut over the slip fielder and down to the third man fence. Welcome boundary and this should make Dhawan feel good.
On the pads, Rahul works it through square leg for one. Slow going from India so far.
Well bowled and good field placement! Length and on off, this lands and moves away. Rahul looks to guide it down to third man but there is a gully in place which fields this.
Good length and on middle, Rahul plays it on the off side.
Rahul was late on that one! Length and around off, this lands and moves away. Rahul is beaten as he tries to defend.
Angled into the pads, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
On the stumps, Rahul is solid in defense.
Good length again and on off, defended.
Really good line! Just outside off, length delivery. Rahul watches it go through to the keeper.
Fuller and on middle, this is worked down to fine leg for one.
Just the two! Dhawan will feel he missed out there! It is short and on the body, Dhawan looks to hit it hard but it goes more off the glove towards fine leg for two.

Leading edge but safe! Dhawan looks to defend, this is on a length and around off, it lands and straightens. It goes off the leading edge but lands short of the fielder at cover. It is a no ball as Victor Nyauchi has overstepped. A chance for Dhawan to get himself going.
On off, defended. The good work from Zimbabwe's opening bowlers continues.
WIDE! Shorter and on middle, Rahul initially looks to pull but then ducks under it. Wided.

DROPPED! That went quickly to him but should have been taken! Dhawan continues to live a charmed life! He has been quite fidgety and has tried to hit the ball really hard! This was short and outside off, Dhawan looks to cut it powerfully, it goes straight to Tony Munyonga at point who spills it. That could prove costly.
Outside off, left alone.
Angled into the pads, Dhawan works it through square leg and takes two.

Edged but short! Dhawan seems to be getting frustrated. He is playing a few shots but not getting a lot of runs off it. Shorter and outside off, Dhawan steps out and slashes at it, it goes off the inside edge and on the bounce to the keeper.
Outside off, Rahul is happy just by guiding it down to third man and taking one.
A maiden and this is the first maiden for Zimbabwe in this series. On off, kept out.
Five dots in a row now! On off, blocked.
Dhawan steps out again but the length is dragged back by Victor Nyauchi! Defended.
Yet another dot! Just outside off, Dhawan watches it go to the keeper.
Angled into the middle pole, Dhawan plays it back to the bowler. Really good stuff, giving nothing away at the moment are the Zimbabwe bowlers.
Outside off, on a length, left alone.
Just the one! Fuller and on middle, Dhawan pushes it down the ground towards long on and gets to the other end. Runs have dried up after the first two overs. Good from Zimbabwe.
Slightly fuller and on off, Dhawan pushes it but to covers.
Dhawan shuffles across this time, Richard Ngarava attacks the stumps but it is worked to mid-wicket.
BEATEN! Extra bounce there! Shorter and outside off, Dhawan slashes at it but is beaten by the extra bounce.
On the pads, this is worked on the leg side for one.
Good length and on off, defended well.
A swing and a miss! Dhawan steps out, he makes room and looks to go over the off side but misses. Back-to-back good overs for the hosts.
Length and on off, Rahul waits and then guides it down to third man for one.
WIDE! This one is slipped down the leg side. Left alone by Rahul. Wided.
Outside off, Rahul leaves it alone.
On off, defended.
That was a good delivery! Length and on middle, this lands and moves away. Rahul looks to defend, it goes off the outer half to point.
More runs for Rahul! On the pads, he works it past square leg and takes two.
A single to end a tidy over from Richard Ngarava! On the pads, this is tucked around the corner on the leg side for one.
Slightly fuller and on off, Rahul lunges and pushes it to covers.
Another one on a length and around off, Rahul plays it to point.
Angled into the pads, Dhawan works it through mid-wicket and gets to the other end.
Just outside off, it is an easy leave for the batter.
Back of a length and on off, Dhawan blocks.
Full and on the leg stump, Shikhar Dhawan flicks it towards backward square leg for a run.
Pulls his length back a bit, around off, Shikhar Dhawan lets it go to the keeper.
FOUR! Nicely timed! This is full and on the pads, Shikhar Dhawan flicks it towards the vacant deep sqaure leg region for a boundary. He is scoring runs all around the park.
This is on a good length and outside off, angling away, Shikhar Dhawan leaves it alone.
Fuller this time, on middle, Shardul Thakur tucks it away towards mid-wicket.
KL Rahul gets off the mark straightaway. Victor Nyauchi starts with a length delivery, angling down the leg, KL Rahul helps it towards fine leg for a single.
Who will bowl from the other end? Victor Nyauchi it is!
Full again and on off, Shikhar Dhawan drives it towards covers and calls for the run but Rahul sends him back. 8 runs from the first over then.
FOUR! Bread and butter for Dhawan! This is slightly overpitched and around off, Shikhar Dhawan leans on and drives it handsomely through covers for his second boundary.
Goes fuller this time, on middle, Shikhar Dhawan pushes it of his inner half towards mid-wicket.
On a good length, on middle, angling in, Shikhar Dhawan blocks it to the off side.
FOUR! India and Shikhar Dhawan are underway in style! This is short and outside off, Shikhar Dhawan cuts it past point for a beautiful boundary.
Richard Ngarava starts with a good-length delivery, on off, Shikhar Dhawan stays there and knocks it towards point.
Time for the action to begin! The Indian openers, KL Rahul and Shikhar Dhawan walk out to the centre. Richard Ngarava has the new ball in hand and he will begin for the hosts. Here we go...

Regis Chakabva, the captain of Zimbabwe says they wanted to bowl first. Mentions they need to take early wickets first up and then try and do well with the bat. Informs they have a couple of changes - Tony Munyonga and Richard Ngarava replaces Wesley Madhevere and Tanaka Chivanga.

KL Rahul, the skipper of India, says they will have a bat first. He says they want to challenge themselves, it is difficult to bat in the first hour or so. Adds Mohammed Siraj has been really good in the last few seasons and has been doing really well lately and is dangerous where the ball is moving. Informs they have two changes, Deepak Chahar and Avesh Khan come in for Prasidh Krishna and Mohammed Siraj.

Zimbabwe (Playing XI) - Takudzwanashe Kaitano, Innocent Kaia, Tony Munyonga (In for Wesley Madhevere), Regis Chakabva (C) (WK), Sikandar Raza, Sean Williams, Ryan Burl, Luke Jongwe, Brad Evans, Victor Nyauchi, Richard Ngarava (In for Tanaka Chivanga).

India (Playing XI) - Shikhar Dhawan, KL Rahul (C), Shubman Gill, Ishan Kishan, Deepak Hooda, Sanju Samson (WK), Axar Patel, Shardul Thakur, Kuldeep Yadav, Deepak Chahar (In for Prasidh Krishna), Avesh Khan (In for Mohammed Siraj).
TOSS - KL Rahul calls correctly for the third time in a row and India have elected to BAT first.

It will be interesting to see if India do give chances to players who are yet to play a game in this series. We might just see Rahul Tripathi make his debut but the question is, where will he bat? In the bowling, Avesh Khan might just get a game. Zimbabwe on the other hand, might just strengthen their batting as that is the department where they have been poor.
